record.title: Isolate frozen control imports from physical evidence
record.intent: Preserve the exact post-seal inventory history and reuse original authority bytes through a separate verified control snapshot.
requirements: Preserve the original 845-file bfb9e72c seal and complete 847-file 4c3cb46f derivative, raw capture and both added bytecode caches. Verify every original artifact unchanged and exactly the two identified additions; do not delete files, rewrite seals, exclude arbitrary extras or claim the earlier full inventory still verifies. Record verifier import provenance and host restoration separately. No specimen, network or host-controller contact.

Reconstruct a fresh external frozen-control snapshot by the exact original 33-file control manifest 00e01ca3, copying only its positively enumerated unchanged bytes from complete preserved evidence. Native-verify that snapshot against the original manifest and bind complete derivative-history provenance. Keep imports and generated bytecode outside actual raw evidence; set no-bytecode before imports.

Create a narrowly named offline composition successor that reuses the unchanged new-boot authority replay, six-field lease values, V5 acquisition generator, ArmReady geometry/current-run membership and numerical contract. Change only the exact external control-root/provenance binding and source pins required for the isolated snapshot. Keep original modules and their preparation seals untouched. Independently inspect source diffs and focused changed inventory/import/containment controls, strict authored typing/Ruff/format. No physical controller or fabricated arm.
acceptance: An independently reviewed exact control snapshot and bounded offline composition are preserved, or the remedy is explicitly held.
